'''Leon Lapidus''' (September 26, 1924 – May 5, 1977) was an American [[chemist]] and chemical engineer, the chairman of the department of chemical engineering at [[Princeton University]],<ref name="NYT">[https://select.nytimes.com/gst/abstract.html?res=FB0713FC3A5D167493C5A9178ED85F438785F9&scp=1&sq=%22leon%20lapidus%22&st=cse New York Times:Leon Lapidus, 52, Professor Of Engineering at Princeton;May 7, 1977]</ref><ref name="NAP">[http://www.nap.edu/openbook.php?record_id=578&page=173 National Academy of Engineering:Memorial Tributes, Volume 1 (1979);by Neal R. Amundson]</ref><ref name="PRINCETON">{{Cite web |url=http://etcweb.princeton.edu/CampusWWW/Companion/chemical_engineering.html |title=Princeton University:Chemical Engineering:Chemical Engineering was first offered at Princeton in 1922 |access-date=2012-01-26 |archive-date=2018-07-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180727154133/http://etcweb.princeton.edu/CampusWWW/Companion/chemical_engineering.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> a member of the [[National Academy of Engineering]],<ref name="NAP"/>
an author of over 100 technical publications.<ref name="NYT"/><ref>[http://www.goodreads.com/author/show/516694.Leon_Lapidus Goodreads:Books by Leon Lapidus]</ref>

Lapidus was noted for his work in the application of computer techniques to chemical engineering for which he was honored with [[William Hultz Walker|William H. Walker]] Award of the [[American Institute of Chemical Engineers]].<ref name="PRINCETON"/>
His distinctions included the William N. Lacey Lectureship,<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.che.caltech.edu/seminars/lacey.html |title=California Institute of Technology;William N. Lacey Lectureship |access-date=2012-01-26 |archive-date=2019-09-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190920083211/http://www.che.caltech.edu/seminars/lacey.html |url-status=dead }}</ref> a membership in the [[American Chemical Society]]<ref name="NYT"/> and in the [[American Institute of Chemical Engineers]],<ref name="NYT"/>
Professional Progress Award in Chemical Engineering of the [[American Institute of Chemical Engineers]].<ref name="NYT"/>
